Three things broke

## Faster coding made the  
right side worse.

01 / PRODUCTION

### Incidents tripled. Engineers are firefighting.

AI-speed output flooded a system built for human-paced development. Incidents per PR are up 243%. Lead time to production is up 480%. Engineers spend more time responding to failures than building.

02 / LEGACY TOOLING

### Your tools were built for humans at human speed.

Better dashboards, cheaper storage, a chat box on top of your data. None of it closes the loop from production back to where the code was written. What breaks in production does not teach the agents that built it.

03 / COST

### Token spend you can't justify. Observability bills you can't control.

AI coding tools generate costs that are invisible to the business. At the same time, more code means more signals, and observability bills grow with every deployment. You are paying more to see less.

## Cost Under Control - No Surprises

Dash0’s transparent pricing ensures you always know what you’re paying for—no hidden fees, no guesswork, just predictable costs.

Price by telemetry

### Pay just for the telemetry you care about

Our pricing is transparent and based on how many logs, spans, and metric data points you send and store. Not how many bytes of it, or how many people query them. This ensures that you only pay for what you use and can send all the metadata that you need, without any hidden costs associated with users or GB. With SignalControl, storage is billed only on the telemetry you keep.

![Pay just for the telemetry you care about](/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fpages%2Ftransparent-cost%2Fimage-bigger.webp&w=1920&q=75)

![Built on the OpenTelemetry Collector](/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fpages%2Ftransparent-cost%2Fframe-2309226-3-.webp&w=3840&q=75)

Open standards

### Built on the OpenTelemetry Collector

SignalControl works with the OpenTelemetry agents and collectors you already run - no proprietary agent, no gateway tier to build. Prefer to manage your own pipelines? Everything stays standard OTel, and otelbin.io is there to help.

## From Engineers, for Engineers

Built by observability experts for developers, SREs, and platform engineers, Dash0 is designed for productivity—focusing on real-world use cases and solving daily challenges effortlessly.

Dash0 is designed for efficiency. Navigate, filter, and explore your entire observability platform using only the keyboard. Enjoy speed and control without relying on a mouse.
